nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged owner address controlling the contract.
Claimable.pendingOwner: address awaiting two-step ownership claim.
ReentrancyGuard._guardValue: reentrancy lock flag (0 = unlocked).
BaseWallet._owner: wallet owner used for module authorization.
BaseWallet.modules: mapping of authorized wallet modules.
BaseWallet.controller: Controller reference used for factory/registry checks.
BaseWallet.methodToModule: selector to module routing table for fallback dispatch.
MetaTxAware.trustedForwarder: address allowed to supply meta-tx sender data.
ENSConsumer.ensRegistry: external ENS registry address used for lookups/setters.
SimpleProxy implementation storage slot holding the delegatecall target.
QuotaStore.defaultQuota: fallback daily spending quota.
QuotaStore.quotas: per-wallet quota/spending accounting struct.
SecurityStore.wallets: per-wallet guardian, lock and inheritance state.
WhitelistStore.effectiveTimeMap: wallet to recipient to whitelist activation time.
HashStore.hashes: consumed signed-request hashes per wallet.
NonceStore.nonces: last accepted meta-tx nonce per wallet.
WalletFactory.blanks: pre-deployed wallet blanks mapped to module-set version.
WalletFactory.walletImplementation: logic implementation installed into proxies.
WalletFactory.DOMAIN_SEPERATOR: EIP-712 domain separator for wallet creation.
AddressSet.sets: keyed address set storage with positions index.
WalletFactory.allowEmptyENS: flag permitting label-less wallet creation.
msg.sender: external caller identity used for all authorization checks.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time source used for quota, lock, whitelist and guardian state.
Low-level call{value:amount, gas:gasLimit} forwarded to an arbitrary recipient in sendETH.
Raw assembly call in fastCall with caller-controlled target and calldata.
Assembly delegatecall in SimpleProxy/Proxy fallback forwarding all calldata to the implementation.
nonReentrantCall mode 1: target.call{value:value}(data) to an arbitrary address.
nonReentrantCall mode 2: target.delegatecall(data) executed in wallet context.
nonReentrantCall mode 3: target.staticcall(data) external read-only call.
CREATE2 contract deployment used for wallet/proxy creation.
Inline assembly extcodehash used to decide whether an address is a contract.
BaseWallet fallback: module.call{value:msg.value}(msg.data) forwarding arbitrary calldata to a module.
Inline assembly returndatacopy/revert bubbling failed call data in transact.
MathUint.mul: multiplication with overflow check used in quota math.
MathUint.sub: subtraction with underflow check used in quota/signature math.
MathUint.add: addition with overflow check used for spent quota accumulation.
Ownable.transferOwnership: owner-only ownership transfer.
Ownable.renounceOwnership: owner-only renunciation of ownership.
Claimable.claimOwnership: pending owner finalizes ownership transfer.
Claimable.transferOwnership: owner sets pendingOwner instead of transferring directly.
BaseWallet.initOwner: factory-only one-time owner initialization.
BaseWallet.initController: one-time controller initialization guarded by state checks.
BaseWallet.setOwner: module-only owner rotation.
BaseWallet.setController: module-only controller replacement.
BaseWallet.addModule: factory-or-module module addition.
BaseWallet.removeModule: module-only module removal with deactivate call.
BaseWallet.bindMethod: module-only selector binding for fallback routing.
BaseWallet.transact: module/factory authorized arbitrary call execution.
BaseWallet.fallback: dispatches msg.data to a bound module after authorization.
BaseWallet.nonReentrantCall: guarded execution of call/delegatecall/staticcall modes.
BaseWallet.addModuleInternal: validates module in registry and activates it.
AddressSet.addAddressToSet: inserts an address and maintains positions index.
AddressSet.removeAddressFromSet: swap-and-pop removal from a set.
AddressSet.isAddressInSet: membership check via positions mapping.
AddressUtil.sendETH: ETH transfer via low-level call with custom gas.
AddressUtil.sendETHAndVerify: sendETH plus success requirement.
AddressUtil.fastCall: raw call with manual return-data copy.
AddressUtil.fastCallAndVerify: fastCall that reverts on failure.
AddressUtil.isContract: extcodehash-based contract detection.
HashStore.verifyAndUpdate: wallet-module-only hash consumption.
NonceStore.verifyAndUpdate: wallet-module-only nonce advancement.
QuotaStore.checkAndAddToSpent: quota validation then spending accumulation.
QuotaStore.addToSpent: writes spent amount and timestamp for a wallet.
WhitelistStore.addToWhitelist: wallet-module-only recipient whitelisting.
WhitelistStore.removeFromWhitelist: wallet-module-only recipient removal.
WhitelistStore.isWhitelisted: timestamp-gated whitelist effectiveness check.
SecurityStore.setLock: wallet-module-only wallet lock with timestamp validation.
SecurityStore.touchLastActive: records wallet activity timestamp.
SecurityStore.setInheritor: wallet-module-only inheritor assignment.
SecurityStore.addGuardian: wallet-module-only guardian addition with validSince.
SecurityStore.isGuardianActive: timestamp-dependent guardian activation check.
WalletFactory.createWallet: signature-validated proxy deployment and initialization.
WalletFactory.createWallet2: consumes a pre-deployed blank wallet.
WalletFactory.createBlanks: batch pre-deployment of wallet blanks.
WalletFactory.initTrustedForwarder: one-time meta-tx forwarder setup (permissionless).
WalletFactory.validateRequest_: EIP-712 owner signature and meta-tx hash validation.
WalletFactory.deploy_: CREATE2 proxy deployment plus wallet initialization.
WalletFactory.initializeWallet_: owner init, registry registration and ENS setup.
WalletFactory.registerENS_: external callback into ENS manager plus optional reverse registration.
SimpleProxy.setImplementation: permissionless one-time implementation slot write.
BaseENSManager.register: manager-only subdomain registration with approval verification.
BaseENSManager.verifyApproval: ECDSA recovery requiring a manager signer.
MetaTxAware.msgSender: derives logical sender from trusted forwarder calldata.
MetaTxAware.txAwareHash: extracts trailing hash from forwarded calldata.
OwnerManagable.addManager: owner-only manager addition.
OwnerManagable.removeManager: owner-only manager removal.
ControllerImpl.initStores: owner-only one-time store wiring.
ControllerImpl.initWalletFactory: owner-only wallet factory configuration.
QuotaStore.changeDefaultQuota: owner-only default quota bounds check.
QuotaStore.changeQuota: wallet-module-only quota scheduling with SafeCast downcasts.
Controller.moduleRegistry: registry consulted for module validity.
Controller.walletRegistry: registry of created wallets.
Controller.walletFactory: trusted factory address used in wallet modifiers.
ControllerImpl.collectTo: fee collection destination address.
ControllerImpl.priceOracle: oracle used for token valuation.
Parameter _initialOwner of BaseWallet.initOwner.
Parameter _controller of BaseWallet.initController.
Parameter newOwner of BaseWallet.setOwner.
Parameter _module of BaseWallet.addModule.
Parameter mode selecting call/delegatecall/staticcall in nonReentrantCall.
Parameter to: destination address of ETH transfer/call.
Parameter value: ETH amount forwarded in external calls.
Parameter data: calldata forwarded to external targets.
Parameter key selecting an AddressSet instance.
Parameter addr inserted into an AddressSet.
Parameter wallet: target wallet whose store state is modified.
Parameter lock: lock expiry timestamp written by setLock.
Parameter nonce validated and stored by NonceStore.verifyAndUpdate.
Parameter amount checked against available quota.
Local pos: positions index read during set removal.
Local set: storage reference to the Set being mutated.
Local success: boolean result of the guarded external call.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor sets owner = msg.sender, making the deployer privileged.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner restricts transferOwnership based on msg.sender.
onlyOwner restricts renounceOwnership based on msg.sender.
onlyPendingOwner compares msg.sender with pendingOwner in claimOwnership.
Claimable.transferOwnership stores the new pendingOwner.
claimOwnership promotes pendingOwner into the owner slot.
onlyFromFactory checks msg.sender against controller.walletFactory() in initOwner.
initOwner writes _owner, the wallet's privileged owner.
initController writes the controller used for authorization checks.
onlyFromModule authorizes setOwner via the modules mapping.
setOwner overwrites the wallet owner state.
setController replaces the controller enforcing module authorization.
addModule delegates the privilege-sensitive work to addModuleInternal.
addModuleInternal enables a module in the modules mapping.
bindMethod validates the target module against the modules mapping.
bindMethod writes the selector to module routing table.
onlyFromModule restricts bindMethod to registered modules.
transact performs the external operation through nonReentrantCall.
nonReentrantCall mode 1 executes target.call{value:value}(data).
nonReentrantCall mode 2 executes delegatecall inside wallet storage context.
nonReentrantCall mode 3 executes an external staticcall.
The _guardValue reentrancy lock protects the external call path.
transact uses inline assembly to bubble revert data from a failed call.
onlyFromFactoryOrModule restricts who may trigger arbitrary transact calls.
fallback resolves the module from msg.sig and authorizes the caller.
fallback forwards msg.value and msg.data to the bound module with a low-level call.
The modules mapping gates fallback dispatch before forwarding calldata.
sendETH performs a low-level value call to a caller-supplied recipient.
sendETHAndVerify wraps sendETH and requires success.
fastCall performs a raw call with attacker-influenced target and data.
fastCallAndVerify delegates to fastCall and reverts on failure.
isContract uses extcodehash assembly, which is sensitive to delegatecall/proxy state.
verifyAndUpdate marks a hash consumed to prevent signature replay.
verifyAndUpdate advances the stored nonce, preventing meta-tx replay.
checkAndAddToSpent validates quota then records spending.
The amount parameter is checked against the wallet's available quota.
addToSpent uses MathUint.add when accumulating spent amounts.
addToSpent writes the per-wallet quota accounting struct.
addToSpent records block.timestamp as the spending time.
changeDefaultQuota modifies the default spending quota.
onlyOwner restricts changeDefaultQuota to the contract owner.
addToWhitelist inserts the recipient through AddressSet logic.
addToWhitelist writes the recipient activation time map.
onlyWalletModule authorizes the wallet module via Wallet(wallet).hasModule(msg.sender).
removeFromWhitelist removes the recipient from the address set.
onlyWalletModule authorizes wallet-module removal of whitelist entries.
isWhitelisted reads the activation time to decide whitelist effectiveness.
isWhitelisted compares effectiveTime against block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
setLock writes a caller-supplied lock timestamp after validating it against block.timestamp.
onlyWalletModule authorizes lock changes and records msg.sender as lockedBy.
touchLastActive writes the wallet's lastActive field.
setInheritor writes the inheritor address into wallet state.
isGuardianActive depends on block.timestamp to decide guardian activation.
addGuardian stores validSince times compared against block.timestamp.
createWallet validates the owner signature before deploying.
createWallet deploys the proxy through deploy_.
createWallet initializes the freshly deployed wallet.
createWallet2 consumes a blank and reuses deployment initialization.
deploy_ uses CREATE2 with a salt-derived address.
deploy_ installs walletImplementation into the proxy.
validateRequest_ hashes with the EIP-712 domain separator.
validateRequest_ reads txAwareHash to bind meta-tx requests.
register verifies the manager approval before assigning ENS names.
addManager inserts the manager into the MANAGER address set.
removeManager removes the manager from the MANAGER address set.
register performs privileged ENS registry writes through ensRegistry.
registerENS_ calls the external ENS manager register function.
initWalletFactory sets the trusted factory address used by wallet modifiers.
initStores wires registries and stores used for authorization.
setImplementation writes the implementation slot that the proxy delegates to.
Proxy fallback reads the implementation slot before delegating all calldata.
Price oracle configuration influences token-value based quota decisions.
changeQuota downcasts and scales quota values, relying on overflow-checked math.
Quota availability computation relies on MathUint.sub for the time-decayed spent amount.
A called module can call back into the wallet fallback and re-enter dispatch.
The external target of transact may re-enter transact on the wallet.
An ETH recipient can re-enter the caller of sendETH before state settles.
Module.activate() is an external call executed while adding the module, allowing re-entry into fallback dispatch.

normalization_plan.reason: Value-only argument of BaseWallet.initOwner; folded into the function node.
Execution-mode selector consumed only by nonReentrantCall branching.
Call destination argument feeding the low-level call in sendETH.
ETH value forwarded by the guarded external call.
Calldata forwarded to the external target.
Set selector argument used solely to resolve AddressSet storage.
Address inserted into the set by addAddressToSet.
Wallet identifier used for the module authorization check in HashStore.
Lock expiry argument validated and stored by setLock.
Nonce argument validated and stored by NonceStore.verifyAndUpdate.
Spending amount argument checked against available quota.
Temporary positions index local used only inside the removal logic.
Transient storage pointer to the Set being mutated.
Call-result boolean local produced by the low-level call.
